detection_name: Excessive Admin-Share Logons by Single Account
summary: Compromised service account 'svc_backup' used for lateral movement to 5 hosts, including a Domain Controller, from WKS-014 after a PsExec execution.

proposed_actions.title: Isolate host WKS-014
proposed_actions.rationale: WKS-014 is the origin of the lateral movement, observed running PsExec with the compromised svc_backup account after a suspicious PowerShell download by user jdoe. Isolation contains the threat at its source.

proposed_actions.title: Disable account svc_backup
proposed_actions.rationale: svc_backup is confirmed compromised and was used to access 5 critical servers including a DC. Disabling it immediately halts all lateral movement capabilities.

proposed_actions.title: Disable account jdoe
proposed_actions.rationale: jdoe was used for the initial suspicious download on WKS-014, the likely initial point of compromise. Disabling it prevents further use of potentially compromised credentials.

proposed_detection.problem: The current detection flags admin-share fan-out on a flat distinct-destination threshold, so it cannot tell a real attacker from a legitimate service account that touches many hosts nightly — producing a steady stream of false positives and alert fatigue.
proposed_detection.current_spl:
index=auth action=logon logon_type=3
| stats dc(dest) as distinct_dests by user
| where distinct_dests > 3
proposed_detection.proposed_spl:
index=edr process_name=PsExec.exe
| fields user, host
| join user [
    search index=auth action=logon logon_type=3
    | stats dc(dest) as distinct_dests by user
    | where distinct_dests > 3
]
proposed_detection.spl_diff:
--- current_spl
+++ proposed_spl
- index=auth action=logon logon_type=3
- | stats dc(dest) as distinct_dests by user
- | where distinct_dests > 3
+ index=edr process_name=PsExec.exe
+ | fields user, host
+ | join user [
+     search index=auth action=logon logon_type=3
+     | stats dc(dest) as distinct_dests by user
+     | where distinct_dests > 3
+ ]
proposed_detection.expected_effect: Correlates the admin-share fan-out with a preceding EDR remote-execution-tool signal (PsExec), eliminating the legitimate service-account false-positive class while retaining the true positive for this attack pattern.
